left.title: ABC News Anchor Caught on Mic Saying Network Quashed Jeffrey Epstein Story
left.body: ABC News anchor Amy Robach was caught on camera slamming her own network for allegedly sitting on the Jeffrey Epstein story three years ago. In a video clip released by right-wing group Project Veritas on Tuesday, Robach is seemingly caught on a hot mic complaining to colleagues that her Epstein story was suppressed by network executives. Robach says she’d spoken to Virginia Roberts Giuffre, who alleges Epstein used her as a sex slave and trafficked her to his powerful friends, including Britain’s Prince Andrew. “I’ve had this interview with Virginia
left.roundup: Conservative watchdog Project Veritas released video Tuesday of ABC News anchor Amy Robach saying the network suppressed her reporting on Jeffrey Epstein. The video, apparently provided by an unnamed ABC employee, shows Robach last summer alleging to an unseen audience that she connected Epstein to Prince Andrew of the British Royal Family, and that ABC avoided the story after the Palace threatened to stop doing interviews with the network. Only right-leaning publications covered the story initially, with more left and center-rated coverage coming as the day progressed. Robach and ABC released separate statements on the video; Robach said she was caught in a "private moment of frustration", and ABC said Robach's reporting did not meet ethical standards.

center.title: ABC says interview with Epstein accuser wasn’t ready to air
center.body: NEW YORK (AP) — ABC News faced questions Tuesday about whether it was reluctant to air a sensitive story about alleged sexual misconduct after a leaked video emerged of its reporter complaining about how her bosses handled an interview with a Jeffrey Epstein accuser. right.title: ABC News’ Amy Robach claims network ‘quashed’ Jeffrey Epstein coverage on hot mic
right.body: ABC News anchor Amy Robach was caught on a hot mic griping about how the network allegedly “quashed” her exclusive coverage of the Jeffrey Epstein sex scandal before it exploded years later. Undated clips showing Robach slamming ABC were made public Tuesday by right-wing group Project Veritas.
